getting-started.title: Start your workspace
getting-started.body: Complete your profile, choose tools and invite people using the live setup checklist.

tools.title: Choose and connect tools
tools.body: Owners start trials or choose plans. Members request access and the owner assigns available seats.

billing.title: Billing and invoices
billing.body: Owners manage saved payment methods, period-end changes, billing contacts and invoice output.

team.title: Invite and manage people
team.body: Invitations reserve real tool capacity. Role changes and restoration respect canonical permissions and seats.

connections.title: Control connected work
connections.body: A connection requires both subscriptions and the required seats. Turning it off keeps the existing source records.

security.title: Account and session controls
security.body: Session lists and sign-out are actual. Enrollment, email, SSO, API keys and webhooks are marked as mock previews.
